description: Approve a pending access request (state=requested → active). Admins / moderators / owner only. Because access requests only exist on non-open (password/private) channels, you must pass wrapped_group_key — the channel group key wrapped to the approved member's identity key.

identity_id.description: Identity id of the requester to reject (state=requested; from mIRC_list members).

wrapped_group_key.description: Required to approve a join to a password/private (group-key) channel: the channel group key wrapped to the approved member's identity key. Without it the backend rejects the approval with a 'wrapped_group_key required' error. (Access requests only exist on non-open channels, so this is effectively always required.)

name: mIRC_approve_request
